items.name: plotter
items.title: Plotter
items.description: Seeded line-drawing generators (flow fields, contours, globes, tunnels, rosettes, harmonographs, spirals, Lissajous knots, ridgelines, routes, hatching, fingerprints, starbursts, gauges, moirés, logo marks and sketched rules) and scrollWindow(), the trigger that finishes a drawing as it reaches the middle of the screen. Every scrollfx block draws with it.

items.name: chart
items.title: Charts
items.description: What the scrollfx charts share: series from a config, nice ticks and scales, monotone curves, markers, hatching for bars, areas and wedges, and the pens that ink a chart in order (axes, hatching, then the lines) as it reaches the middle of the screen.

items.name: hero-flow-field
items.title: Hero, flow field
items.description: A hero beside a print: a round flow field of several hundred strokes, plotted top to bottom on arrival, with a live stroke count.

items.name: logos-plotted
items.title: Plotted logo cloud
items.description: A logo cloud between two rules a pen draws across the page, each name beside a simple mark it plots line by line: rings, a hatched disc, triangles, waves, a ruled square, a burst.

items.name: hatch-highlight
items.title: Hatched highlight
items.description: A large statement whose key phrases a pen hatches over as they are read, like a proof marked up by hand.

items.name: plotted-chart
items.title: Plotted chart
items.description: Figures that count up beside an area chart a pen plots as you scroll: hatched in from left to right, the curve drawn over it.

items.name: feature-plates
items.title: Feature plates
items.description: Features beside plates a pen draws as you reach them: a topographic map, a wireframe globe, a tunnel of turning squares.

items.name: bento-plotted
items.title: Plotted bento grid
items.description: A bento grid of cards in mixed sizes, each with a drawing of its own: a moiré of two ring sets, a Lissajous knot, a rosette, ridgelines and a globe.

items.name: steps-route
items.title: Steps on a route
items.description: How it works as a route on a map: numbered stops a pen rings in turn, joined by a line that wanders from one to the next and ends on a cross.

items.name: stats-plotted
items.title: Plotted stats
items.description: Figures that count up, each over a gauge a pen plots tick by tick, with an accent band out to the figure's share of the dial and a needle pointing at it.

items.name: changelog-plotted
items.title: Plotted changelog
items.description: Releases down a rail that inks itself as you read, each stamped with a rosette drawn from its version number.

items.name: pricing-plotted
items.title: Plotted pricing
items.description: Plans headed by marks that grow denser with the plan, the recommended one framed by a pen that goes round it twice, and prices that count.

items.name: testimonials-plotted
items.title: Plotted testimonials
items.description: Quotes on sheets, each stamped with a spiral a pen winds from the rim inward, seeded from the person's name, with their initials in its eye.

items.name: team-plotted
items.title: Team with fingerprints
items.description: The people behind the product, each over a fingerprint seeded from their name, drawn ring by ring from the core outward.

items.name: faq-plotted
items.title: Plotted FAQ
items.description: Questions that open in place with the browser's own disclosure, beside a plate where a pen draws a Lissajous knot.

items.name: newsletter-plotted
items.title: Starburst sign-up
items.description: A newsletter sign-up beside a starburst a pen draws ray by ray, clockwise from the top, with every twelfth ray in the accent colour.

items.name: cta-harmonograph
items.title: Harmonograph call to action
items.description: The closing call to action beside a harmonograph: one unbroken line, the trace of two pendulums, drawn as the section arrives.

items.name: footer-plotted
items.title: Plotted footer
items.description: A footer under a horizon of ridgelines a pen plots back to front as it comes into view, with link columns and a closing line below.

items.name: chart-line
items.title: Line chart
items.description: A line chart a pen plots as you scroll: gridlines, then each series left to right, the first in the accent, then a marker on every point. One series or several; smooth, straight or stepped.

items.name: chart-area
items.title: Area chart
items.description: An area chart hatched in stroke by stroke under its curve, then the curve drawn over it in the accent. One series, or several stacked, each with its own hatch.

items.name: chart-bar
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Hatched bars, outlined by the pen as you scroll. Vertical or horizontal, one series, grouped side by side, or stacked.

items.name: chart-pie
items.title: Pie chart
items.description: A pie or donut whose wedges are shaded by hatching of different angles and densities, the way a plotter shades without colour, then outlined.

items.name: chart-radar
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: A radar chart: rings and spokes, then each series' shape hatched in and outlined, the first in the accent.

items.name: chart-scatter
items.title: Scatter chart
items.description: Points plotted left to right as small marks, one shape per series, with an optional fitted trend line drawn last.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny inline line for tables and stat cards, drawn as it reaches the middle of the screen, with an optional hatched area and an end dot.

items.name: ink
items.title: Ink
items.description: What the ink components share: in lib/ink-core.ts, the same file in React, Vue and Svelte, ink(), which hands an svg to svg-scroll-draw on the scroll (finishing at mid-screen) or once in view, the strokes each component draws, and Hershey's script, a public-domain single-stroke handwriting font, laid out by script(); in lib/ink.ts, the React hooks useInk() and useSize().

items.name: ink-highlight
items.title: Ink highlight
items.description: A mark a pen makes on words in running text: underline, double underline, circle, box, strike or hatch fill. Inline in a paragraph, one mark per line when the words wrap.

items.name: ink-divider
items.title: Ink divider
items.description: A rule a pen draws across the page: straight, wavy, sketchy (ink then accent), dotted, or two rules drawn outward from a label.

items.name: ink-frame
items.title: Ink frame
items.description: A border a pen draws round any children: rect or rounded (twice round, ink then accent), double, or crop marks at the corners.

items.name: ink-progress
items.title: Ink progress
items.description: A value plotted as it is reached: a bar hatched in to the value, a ring with an accent band, or a ticked gauge with a needle. role="progressbar".

items.name: ink-stamp
items.title: Ink stamp
items.description: A short word or two inside a plotted stamp: a circle with text round its rim, a rectangle ruled twice, or a scalloped seal, set a little askew.

items.name: ink-signature
items.title: Ink signature
items.description: A name written stroke by stroke at one steady speed in Hershey's single-stroke script, underlined with a flourish; or your own signature as SVG paths.

items.name: ink-arrow
items.title: Ink arrow
items.description: A hand-drawn arrow pointing at something: nearly straight, curved, or looped, with a head made in one stroke.
